articles.title: Bryson DeChambeau and Mikayla Demaiter’s explosive relationship that is shaking up the world of golf
articles.standfirst: The two-time U.S. Open champion and former hockey player have reportedly gone from rumors to an official romance
articles.summary: The two-time U.S. Open champion and former hockey player have reportedly gone from rumors to an official romance
articles.body:
Bryson DeChambeau 's latest development has nothing to do with a driver, a putter or his next LIV Golf tournament.

The two-time U.S. Open champion has reportedly found himself at the center of a new romance with social-media personality Mikayla Demaiter , adding a major dose of celebrity attention to his already high-profile life.

The relationship was confirmed on Wednesday after weeks of speculation surrounding the pair. Us Weekly reported that DeChambeau and Demaiter are dating, while a source described the couple as being “very happy.” TMZ subsequently confirmed the relationship.

The romance had been attracting attention before either report emerged. Demaiter was spotted at the LIV Golf New York tournament earlier this month with a guest pass, and eagle-eyed fans noticed another significant detail: she was wearing a Crushers GC hat.

That was hardly an ordinary choice. DeChambeau is the captain of Crushers GC, the LIV team he has led since joining the Saudi-backed league in 2022.

The team has become closely associated with his identity on the circuit, making Demaiter's appearance particularly interesting to fans already watching the pair's social-media activity.

Speculation intensified further when Demaiter was reportedly seen in what appeared to be DeChambeau's home gym. Those sightings gave fans additional reasons to believe there was more happening between the two than a casual friendship.

Now, however, the speculation has effectively been replaced by confirmation.

Demaiter is not simply an influencer who suddenly appeared alongside a professional golfer. Before building a huge social-media following and pursuing modeling, she was a hockey player and a goaltender.

She left hockey at a young age because of injury and subsequently built a career online, where her combination of sports background, fashion and lifestyle content helped her attract millions of followers.

Her previous relationship was with former NHL player Kurtis Gabriel , meaning her connection to the sporting world predates her romance with DeChambeau .

DeChambeau , meanwhile, is one of the most recognizable figures in modern golf. His scientific approach to the game, enormous driving distance and unconventional personality have made him a particularly prominent LIV Golf player.

He also remains one of the strongest major performers among LIV players. LIV Golf has highlighted his two U.S. Open victories and his continued ability to compete at the biggest tournaments, while he captains Crushers GC.

The timing of the relationship is also intriguing because DeChambeau's golf career remains under considerable attention.

He is approaching the final stages of the 2026 LIV season, while the league itself is dealing with uncertainty over its future after the Saudi Public Investment Fund withdrew its financial backing.

That means DeChambeau has plenty happening away from his personal life as well.

Reports suggest Demaiter intends to continue supporting him at LIV events, potentially including the tournament near Indianapolis.

That could give golf fans plenty more opportunities to see the new couple together.

The relationship is reportedly being kept relatively private, and neither DeChambeau nor Demaiter has publicly offered extensive details.

That approach may be deliberate, particularly given the level of attention both already receive independently.

Still, their pairing has quickly become one of the more unexpected sports-and-social-media romances of the year.

For DeChambeau , the focus will ultimately remain on golf. But with Demaiter now reportedly in his corner, his upcoming tournaments could attract attention from an audience well beyond the usual LIV Golf crowd.

And if she continues appearing at Crushers events, the spotlight surrounding their relationship is unlikely to disappear anytime soon.

articles.title: “Unrecognizable”: Tiger Woods sparks concern among fans in a rare video appearance since his DUI arrest
articles.standfirst: Golf legend returns to the spotlight with heartfelt message for longtime friend Notah Begay III
articles.summary: Golf legend returns to the spotlight with heartfelt message for longtime friend Notah Begay III
articles.body:
T iger Woods has made another rare public appearance months after his March DUI arrest, but rather than his words, it was his appearance on camera that became the main talking point among some fans.

The 50-year-old golf legend appeared in a pre-recorded video during Tuesday night's Payne Stewart Award ceremony, where he paid tribute to longtime friend and former professional golfer Notah Begay III.

Begay was being honored for his character, sportsmanship and extensive charitable work supporting Native American communities and young people.

Woods and Begay have known each other since their youth, with their friendship eventually continuing through their college years at Stanford and their careers in professional golf. Woods used the video to reflect on how long they had been part of each other's lives.

“Hey, Notah. It’s been an unbelievable ride with you. You first came into my life when I was 11-years-old, playing in the junior world and you came to watch me play. Our friendship has started there and never ended,” Woods said in the video.

He then focused on Begay's work away from competitive golf, highlighting the impact he has made through his foundation and his efforts to help young people.

“To see what you’ve done off the golf course, I know you’ve won four times on the tour, playing in the President’s Cup … but to see what you’ve done off the course and for your local Native American communities, you’ve helped over 80,000 youths and their families, which is absolutely incredible. What an amazing job at the sports complex in San Felipe.”

Woods' appearance draws a wave of reactions online

The message was intended as a tribute to Begay , but footage of Woods quickly circulated online and prompted a very different conversation.

Several viewers said they were concerned by what they perceived as changes in Woods ' appearance.

One X user wrote, “Tiger looks a shell of his former self sadly,” while another asked, “What’s going on with the big cat? Looks different for sure.” A third commenter added, “Geez, Tiger doesn’t look so good.”

Not everyone interpreted the footage negatively. Some fans pushed back against the speculation and argued that viewers should avoid drawing conclusions about Woods' health from a short, pre-recorded appearance.

That distinction is important because Woods has not publicly attributed his appearance to any particular medical issue. The online reactions remain opinions from viewers rather than a confirmed assessment of his condition.

The video comes during a difficult period for the 15-time major champion. Woods was arrested following a rollover crash in South Florida in March and has pleaded not guilty to misdemeanor charges related to DUI with property damage and refusing to submit to a lawful test.

Prosecutors have continued their investigation, with Woods scheduled for an in-person court appearance on September 8.

The golfer also spent time in Switzerland receiving treatment after the incident. In a statement following the arrest, Woods acknowledged the seriousness of his situation and said he intended to prioritize his health and recovery.

Despite the circumstances surrounding his recent absence, Woods ' message to Begay offered a glimpse of a more personal side of the golfing icon.

“You’ve done an amazing job. I just think more people need to know what you’ve done and how you’ve served, and you’ve given back to the tribal lands and what you have done.” Woods continued.

“There are so many people out there who are struggling in those communities and you’re trying to raise the bar to allow them to go on and achieve a lot more in life and have the successes that I think they deserve and you feel they deserve.

“Again, thank you for coming to see me play. Thank you for getting our friendship started and I love you dude.”

For Begay , the recognition was a significant moment. The PGA Tour selected him as the 2026 Payne Stewart Award recipient in recognition of his character, sportsmanship and commitment to charitable giving, with the award also carrying a $500,000 grant for charitable initiatives.

For Woods , meanwhile, the brief appearance provided one of the clearest public glimpses of him in months.

With his legal proceedings approaching and his competitive future still uncertain, the video served as a reminder that his focus currently extends well beyond golf.

The reaction to his appearance may continue to generate discussion, but the substance of Woods' message was unmistakably about his longtime friend's contribution to others rather than himself.

articles.title: Paige Spiranac reveals her ‘liquid gold’ kitchen secret after admitting some things are ‘hard to get down’
articles.standfirst: The golf personality only wanted to show people how she makes breakfast. At least, that was the idea
articles.summary: The golf personality only wanted to show people how she makes breakfast. At least, that was the idea
articles.body:
F rom her kitchen, dressed in skin-tight blue leggings and a matching yellow-and-blue top that highlighted her sculpted figure , Paige Spiranac began preparing one of her favorite yogurt bowls. But it didn't take long for a few perfectly innocent comments about things being “thick,” “hard to get down” and needing a little “liquid gold” to give the morning recipe an unintentionally cheeky twist.

“Hi friends, I thought I would share my yogurt bowl recipe with you because no one asked,” Spiranac joked at the beginning, immediately setting the relaxed tone. She started with lactose-free Greek yogurt, explaining that while she loves it, eating a lot of Greek yogurt first thing in the morning can sometimes be a challenge because of its consistency.

“Sometimes I feel like in the morning if you're eating a lot of Greek yogurt, the consistency can just get a little bit thick. Hard to get down,” she explained.

Paige Spiranac has a ‘liquid gold’ solution

That's when Spiranac reached for what she enthusiastically called her “liquid gold.” She poured it into the yogurt to loosen the consistency, explaining that the simple addition makes the mixture “smooth and delicious.”

The words may have invited a double take, but Paige remained completely focused on building her breakfast.

Next came chocolate-peanut-butter protein powder, followed by vanilla chocolate chip granola.

And despite how carefully she assembled this particular combination, Spiranac made clear there really aren't many rules . Vanilla, strawberry or chocolate protein powder can all work, while different granolas and fresh fruit can completely change the bowl.

“You can do whatever you want,” she said as she finished the recipe. It was supposed to be nothing more than a quick glimpse at Paige Spiranac's breakfast routine, yet between the playful wording, her striking kitchen look and that mysterious “liquid gold,” she somehow managed to make a bowl of Greek yogurt considerably more interesting than it had any right to be.

articles.title: Tour Championship winners: Complete history of players to win the golf tournament
articles.standfirst: From Tom Watson to Tommy Fleetwood, some of golf's biggest names have conquered the PGA Tour finale.
articles.summary: From Tom Watson to Tommy Fleetwood, some of golf's biggest names have conquered the PGA Tour finale.
articles.body:
The Tour Championship has been producing champions since 1987, with its roll of honor featuring Tiger Woods, Rory McIlroy, Phil Mickelson and many other major winners.

Tommy Fleetwood became the latest champion in 2025, winning at East Lake with an 18 under total of 262 and collecting the $10 million first prize.

The 2026 champion has yet to be crowned, meaning Fleetwood remains the most recent name added to a history stretching almost four decades.

From Tom Watson to the Tiger Woods era

Tom Watson won the inaugural tournament in 1987, followed by Curtis Strange in 1988, Tom Kite in 1989 and Jodie Mudd in 1990.

Craig Stadler took the title in 1991, before Paul Azinger in 1992, Jim Gallagher Jr . in 1993, Mark McCumber in 1994, Billy Mayfair in 1995 and Tom Lehman in 1996.

David Duval won in 1997 and Hal Sutton followed in 1998, before Tiger Woods claimed his first Tour Championship in 1999.

Phil Mickelson interrupted Woods ' run by winning in 2000, with Mike Weir taking 2001, Vijay Singh 2002, Chad Campbell 2003, Retief Goosen 2004, Bart Bryant 2005 and Adam Scott 2006.

Woods returned spectacularly in 2007, winning by eight strokes with a tournament record 257. Camilo Villegas won in 2008 before Mickelson collected his second title in 2009.

McIlroy joins Woods as the tournament's record winner

Jim Furyk won in 2010, followed by Bill Haas in 2011, Brandt Snedeker in 2012, Henrik Stenson in 2013, Billy Horschel in 2014 and Jordan Spieth in 2015.

Rory McIlroy earned his first victory in 2016 before Xander Schauffele won in 2017. Woods then completed one of golf's most memorable comebacks by capturing his third Tour Championship in 2018.

McIlroy matched that record over the following years. He won again in 2019 and, after Dustin Johnson took 2020 and Patrick Cantlay won 2021, secured his third title in 2022.

Viktor Hovland followed in 2023, with Scottie Scheffler winning in 2024 and Fleetwood succeeding him in 2025.

That leaves Woods and McIlroy tied as the Tour Championship's most successful players with three victories each, while Mickelson is the only other multiple champion with two.

articles.title: Is it appropriate? Paige Spiranac divides fans with a new, viral golf look
articles.standfirst: Spiranac's unconventional golf style is sparking another heated debate online
articles.summary: Spiranac's unconventional golf style is sparking another heated debate online
articles.body:
Paige Spiranac has once again sparked a lively debate among golf fans after sharing a new photo of herself in a form-fitting outfit.

The former professional golfer and collegiate standout, who played for the University of Arizona and San Diego State University, has long been known for taking a less traditional approach to golf fashion.

While many players stick closely to collared shirts, conservative shorts and other established course attire, Spiranac has built her public image around athletic clothing that she says makes her feel comfortable.

Her latest post continued that trend. Spiranac shared a mirror selfie wearing a tight black golf outfit and asked her followers whether they liked the look. The post quickly attracted thousands of likes and a wave of responses, with many fans praising her appearance and style.

However, not everyone was convinced the outfit belonged on a golf course. Some commenters suggested that while the look suited Spiranac , it wasn't necessarily appropriate for every course or club.

Others focused less on golf etiquette and more on how effortlessly she continues to command attention whenever she posts.

The discussion has become familiar territory for Spiranac . Her clothing choices have generated discussion throughout her career, especially because they don't always fit the traditional image associated with golf.

Why Paige Spiranac doesn't follow traditional golf fashion

As Spiranac has noted several times, dressing differently isn't just about making headlines.

"I was a gymnast before I switched into golf," Spiranac told Sports Illustrated. "I was so comfortable wearing spandex and very little of it because that's just what you wear when you're wearing a leotard and you're competing.

“When I switched into golf, we were struggling a little bit financially and so I didn't have the luxury to go out and buy a whole new golf-appropriate wardrobe.”

That experience eventually became part of her philosophy. Spiranac has repeatedly argued that athletes should be able to wear clothing that makes them feel confident, rather than automatically conforming to traditional expectations.

In 2025, she again defended her preference for sexy, form-fitting golf attire and encouraged people to embrace their individual style.

Her enormous social media following has also helped turn those fashion discussions into a major part of her online career. Spiranac now reaches millions of people through platforms including Instagram and X, where golf content sits alongside lifestyle and entertainment posts.

She recently demonstrated just how broad that audience has become by moving beyond golf altogether. A cooking video featuring her yogurt bowl recipe attracted millions of views, proving that her followers aren't necessarily there just for golf tips.

Whether her latest outfit is appropriate will likely remain a matter of personal opinion, but for Spiranac , the fact she's comfortable wearing it means she's happy to play in it.

articles.title: Making grandpa Donald proud: Kai Trump goes viral with official Miami Hurricanes golf photo
articles.standfirst: The Hurricanes freshman posed with an American flag as she begins major new chapter
articles.summary: The Hurricanes freshman posed with an American flag as she begins major new chapter
articles.body:
Kai Trump has spent the past few days adjusting to college life, but one official University of Miami golf photo has now become the clearest symbol of her arrival.

The 19-year-old freshman shared a new set of Hurricanes team pictures on Monday, including one image in which she posed with an American flag draped across her shoulders.

“Year 1 #gocanes,” Trump wrote alongside the photos.

The post quickly attracted thousands of likes as she formally introduced herself as a Miami golfer, nearly two years after first announcing her commitment to the program.

The moment comes at the end of an emotional transition into college life. Trump recently admitted that leaving home had hit her harder than expected, even as she remained excited about beginning the next stage of her career.

“I've been, like, literally sobbing,” she said in a recent vlog. “I think knowing I have to say goodbye to everyone tonight, it, like, really, really sucks.” She added: “I'm excited. It's just, like, I'm emotional.”

Kai Trump arrives at Miami

Trump isn't entering the Hurricanes program without a competitive background.

She played at The Benjamin School in Florida and helped her high school team win four consecutive district championships.

Her junior resume also includes a runner-up finish at the 2025 Major Championship at Village Golf Course and second place at the 2024 Martin County Junior Open.

Her most high-profile test came before college when she received a sponsor exemption into The ANNIKA on the LPGA Tour.

Trump opened with an 83 before improving by eight shots with a second-round 75, ultimately missing the cut.

“I was definitely more nervous than I expected, but I thought I hit a lot of great shots out there,” she said afterward. “I hit a lot of good shots just to the wrong spots.”

She also took confidence from seeing how her game compared with some of the best players in the world.

“It was pretty cool because I know I hit it far, but kind of playing with the best players in the world and being literally right there or even outdriving on some of the holes, it felt pretty good,” Trump said.

New chapter extends beyond the golf course

The official photos arrive after a hectic move into her first college apartment.

Her mother, Vanessa Trump , helped with the transition, including a marathon Target trip that filled four shopping carts with everything from kitchen equipment to cleaning supplies.

The move carried added emotional weight after Vanessa revealed earlier this year that she had been diagnosed with breast cancer.

Kai recently offered an encouraging update, saying her mother was doing “a lot better” following treatment and surgery, while describing the past few months as “a little bit of a rocky road.”

Now the goodbyes are over, classes have started and golf practice is underway. Kai Trump ’s first official Miami photos therefore represent more than a social-media moment.

Trump opened with an 83 before improving by eight shots with a second-round 75, ultimately missing the cut.
“I was definitely more nervous than I expected, but I thought I hit a lot of great shots out there,” she said afterward. “I hit a lot of good shots just to the wrong spots.”
She also took confidence from seeing how her game compared with some of the best players in the world.

“It was pretty cool because I know I hit it far, but kind of playing with the best players in the world and being literally right there or even outdriving on some of the holes, it felt pretty good,” Trump said.
New chapter extends beyond the golf course
The official photos arrive after a hectic move into her first college apartment.
Her mother, Vanessa Trump , helped with the transition, including a marathon Target trip that filled four shopping carts with everything from kitchen equipment to cleaning supplies.
The move carried added emotional weight after Vanessa revealed earlier this year that she had been diagnosed with breast cancer.
Kai recently offered an encouraging update, saying her mother was doing “a lot better” following treatment and surgery, while describing the past few months as “a little bit of a rocky road.”
Now the goodbyes are over, classes have started and golf practice is underway. Kai Trump ’s first official Miami photos therefore represent more than a social-media moment.

articles.title: Tiger Woods changes course on not guilty plea in DUI crash case
articles.standfirst: The golf legend is due back in court after changing his legal strategy.
articles.summary: The golf legend is due back in court after changing his legal strategy.
articles.body:
Tiger Woods is preparing to change his not guilty plea in the Florida DUI case stemming from his March rollover crash, marking a significant development five months after his arrest.

Court records show Woods is scheduled to appear before Judge Darren Steele in Martin County on Wednesday morning for a change of plea hearing.

However, the exact nature of his new plea hasn't been disclosed, meaning it shouldn't yet be assumed that Woods will plead guilty or has reached a deal with prosecutors.

Tiger Woods changes course after initial not guilty plea

Woods originally pleaded not guilty after his Land Rover collided with a trailer being pulled by a truck near his Jupiter Island home on March 27.

He was charged with misdemeanor DUI involving property damage and refusing to submit to a lawful test.

Authorities said Woods showed signs of impairment at the scene. A Breathalyzer detected no alcohol, but deputies reported finding two hydrocodone pills in his possession and said he later refused a urine test.

The crash caused approximately $5,000 in damage, although nobody was injured.

Woods told authorities he had been looking at his phone and changing radio stations before the collision.

Woods previously announced he was seeking treatment

Days after his arrest, Woods publicly acknowledged the seriousness of the situation and announced that he would step away from golf.

"I know and understand the seriousness of the situation I find myself in today," Woods said.

"I am stepping away for a period of time to seek treatment and focus on my health. This is necessary in order for me to prioritize my well-being and work toward lasting recovery."

He also made clear that his priority was making meaningful changes.

"I'm committed to taking the time needed to return in a healthier, stronger, and more focused place, both personally and professionally," Woods said.

Woods was subsequently granted permission by the court to travel overseas for inpatient treatment.

His decision to change his plea now represents the biggest legal development in the case since that initial not guilty response.

But until Wednesday's hearing takes place, one crucial detail remains unknown: exactly what plea Woods intends to enter and whether it forms part of an agreement with prosecutors.

articles.title: Tiger Woods strikes plea deal in Florida DUI case, avoids jail but loses license for 5 years
articles.standfirst: The golfer pleaded guilty to reckless driving
articles.summary: The golfer pleaded guilty to reckless driving
articles.body:
Tiger Woods has pleaded guilty to reckless driving and refusing to submit to a legal test after the accident in Jupiter earlier this year. The 50-year-old megastar has accepted a 5-year suspension of his driver's license and a $1,000 fine . The charges that could have led to prison have been dropped. If he is stopped again while driving, he will go to jail immediately.

He had initially pleaded not guilty, but had to appear in person after filing a motion to change his plea . Tiger was arrested on March 27 by Florida city police officers, accused of driving under the influence of alcohol with property damage and of refusing to take a breathalyzer test after the accident that occurred on South Beach Road. Woods was then issued a traffic fine for careless driving of $163.

His Land Rover crashed into a trailer traveling in the opposite direction and overturned in the middle of the roadway . Woods got out of the vehicle under his own power. When the officers arrived, he refused to take the breathalyzer test and said he had not consumed alcohol. When asked whether he was taking medication, he said yes, and two hydrocodone pills, a powerful painkiller, were found in his pockets.

Taken to the police station, Tiger underwent a breathalyzer test to measure his blood alcohol level. The test returned a result of 0.00 on two occasions. A blood alcohol level of 0.08 or higher is considered illegal in the United States.

articles.title: Donald Trump backs Tiger Woods after five-year driving ban following Florida plea deal
articles.standfirst: The president called Woods a “very special guy” after the golf legend avoided a DUI conviction and accepted a five-year suspension
articles.summary: The president called Woods a “very special guy” after the golf legend avoided a DUI conviction and accepted a five-year suspension
articles.body:
D onald Trump came to Tiger Woods ' defense Wednesday after the 15-time major champion reached a plea agreement that ended his Florida impaired-driving case with a five-year suspension of his driver's license.

Trump , speaking after Woods appeared in Martin County court, described the golfer as a close friend and emphasized the physical pain Woods has endured throughout his career.

The president also pointed to the prescription medication Woods had taken before the March rollover crash.

"Well, look, I know Tiger very well. He's a great guy. He's unique in so many ways, especially as an athlete but also as a man," Trump said.

"He suffers great pain, great pain. It's a very tough situation because they didn't find alcohol on him. He didn't test positive at all for alcohol, but because of his horrible back, because of his bad doctor, but he had a back operation that did not work out well, and he is under pain.

"And so it's a tough deal when you're taking a painkiller because you're under pain and tremendous pain, and you have a problem and you test positive. He would have told him that. I mean, it's a prescription painkiller.

"But I thought it was very fair, he's going to have somebody drive him. I told him that a long time, 'why don't you just get somebody to drive you?' So he's going to have somebody drive him from now on, and you know, he's just a very special guy and I'm glad it's resolved."

The comments came hours after Woods appeared at the Martin County Courthouse in Stuart, Florida, where prosecutors and his defense team finalized a deal that significantly reduced the charges against him.

Woods , 50, entered a no-contest plea to reckless driving, while another charge was reduced to careless driving. He received a $1,000 fine for the reckless-driving conviction and another $500 fine for the careless-driving charge.

The two five-year license suspensions will run concurrently, meaning Woods cannot legally drive for five years rather than facing consecutive bans.

The agreement allowed Woods to avoid a conviction on the original DUI allegation. Prosecutors had initially accused him of driving under the influence with property damage and refusing to submit to a lawful test following the March 27 crash near his Jupiter Island home.

Woods' medication became central to the case

The crash became a major story after Woods ' Land Rover overturned while he was driving near his Florida residence.

Authorities reported signs that raised concerns about impairment, while a breath test showed no alcohol in his system. Woods also declined to provide a urine sample, according to authorities.

Investigators found two pills that were later identified as hydrocodone, a prescription opioid commonly used for pain. Woods had told officers that he had taken prescription medications earlier that day.

However, the prosecution's case faced a significant hurdle when toxicologists reviewed Woods ' medical and prescription history.

State Attorney Thomas Bakkedahl said two toxicologists concluded there was insufficient evidence to prove Woods was impaired by hydrocodone at the time of the crash and found that he had developed a pharmacological tolerance to pain medication after years of use.

That evidence helped pave the way for the reduced charges. The judge nonetheless made clear that Woods' driving privileges would not return anytime soon.

During Wednesday's hearing, Woods received a direct warning about violating the suspension.

"If you drive for any reason at all, you will be going back to jail," the judge told him.

The five-year suspension is a substantial consequence for Woods, but it represents a considerably different outcome from the DUI case he initially faced. Woods had originally pleaded not guilty after his March arrest, and the case remained unresolved for months.

Woods attended the hearing alongside his attorney, Douglas Duncan, and his girlfriend, Vanessa Trump . The appearance marked another public moment for Woods following a difficult stretch that has included the crash, medical treatment and continued questions about his future in professional golf.

After the accident, Woods announced that he would step away from public life to focus on his health.

"I know and understand the seriousness of the situation I find myself in today," Woods said. “I am stepping away for a period of time to seek treatment and focus on my health. This is necessary in order for me to prioritise my well-being and work toward lasting recovery."

Woods subsequently traveled to Switzerland for treatment and spent an extended period away from the public eye.

He eventually returned to the golf scene, making a public appearance at the Travelers Championship in June without addressing the details of his legal situation.

There is now one particularly unusual question surrounding the five-year suspension: Can Woods still drive a golf cart?

Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis indicated that Woods should be able to operate a golf cart on a golf course, an important distinction as Woods remains eligible for the PGA Tour Champions.

Carts are permitted in Champions Tour competition, potentially making the issue relevant if Woods eventually returns to competitive golf. For now, though, Woods has another priority.

The legal case that followed his March crash is over, his DUI charge was reduced and his immediate punishment is clear. He cannot drive a road vehicle for the next five years, and any violation could carry serious consequences.

Trump, meanwhile, believes the resolution was fair and has urged his longtime friend to let someone else take the wheel.

After years of physical setbacks and another turbulent chapter away from competition, Woods can now turn his attention back toward his health and, potentially, one more return to the golf course.

articles.title: Can Tiger Woods drive a golf cart after losing his license? Florida governor gives answer
articles.standfirst: Ron DeSantis has weighed in on whether Woods can still drive a golf cart
articles.summary: Ron DeSantis has weighed in on whether Woods can still drive a golf cart
articles.body:
Tiger Woods left court Wednesday with a five-year driving suspension, but the unusual consequences of that punishment quickly produced a question few defendants ever have to answer and that is whether the conviction can also stop him from driving a golf cart?

That became a legitimate point of discussion because Woods is 50, eligible for the PGA Tour Champions and has increasingly relied on carts while managing the physical effects of his previous injuries.

Florida Governor Ron DeSantis has now weighed in, and his view is straightforward.

“Tiger should be able to drive a golf cart on the golf course,” DeSantis wrote on X.

The comment came after Florida State Attorney Thomas Bakkedahl was asked about the issue following Woods’ court hearing in Stuart. “Can Tiger legally drive his own golf cart?” a reporter asked.

“Oh my god, that's a question...” Bakkedahl replied. “You know what, you got me. We'll have to look into that, I'll get back to you.

“I know you cannot drive a golf cart while impaired on the roads because it is a vehicle, but I don't... my gut reaction is going to be no.”

Why the golf-cart question matters for Woods

The issue is more than a legal quirk. Woods became eligible for the PGA Tour Champions after turning 50, and players on the senior circuit are permitted to use golf carts during competition.

Given the serious injuries he suffered in his 2021 car crash, that could become important if he eventually decides to play on the over-50 circuit.

Woods has also used carts in events such as the PNC Championship while competing alongside his son, Charlie .

That means he could face an unusual reality over the next five years as he's unable to legally drive on public roads, but still permitted to get behind the wheel of a golf cart during professional golf.

Driving ban follows plea agreement

The question emerged after Woods agreed not to contest a reckless driving charge tied to his March 27 crash. His vehicle clipped a truck and rolled over, although no one was injured. Body-camera footage later showed Woods explaining what happened.

“I looked down at my phone, and all of a sudden, boom,” he told officers.

Woods passed a breathalyzer test and said he had not consumed alcohol that day. When asked about prescription medication, he said: “I take a few.”

Authorities later reported finding hydrocodone in his pocket, while officers said they suspected his “normal faculties” were impaired by an unknown substance. After the incident, Woods announced he would seek treatment.

“I know and understand the seriousness of the situation I find myself in today,” he said. “I am stepping away for a period of time to seek treatment and focus on my health.”

His competitive future remains uncertain. But if Woods does return, particularly on the PGA Tour Champions, his lack of a driving license may not prevent one familiar sight.

According to Florida’s governor, he should still be able to drive a cart down the fairway.

articles.title: From teenage golfer to a full-fledged fashion girl: the transformation of Kai Trump, Donald Trump’s granddaughter, that surprises everyone
articles.standfirst: At 19 years old, the young woman is building an identity of her own between sports, social media, her studies, and the enormous weight of belonging to one of the most well-known families in the United States.
articles.summary: At 19 years old, the young woman is building an identity of her own between sports, social media, her studies, and the enormous weight of belonging to one of the most well-known families in the United States.
articles.body:
"K ai Trump, born on May 12, 2007, in New York, Kai is the eldest daughter of Donald Trump Jr. and Vanessa Trump, and the first granddaughter of Donald Trump . Her parents married in 2005 and had five children before divorcing.

She grew up mainly in Florida and from a very young age was surrounded by an environment where business, politics, the media, and sports were part of everyday life. The activity that ended up shaping her own path was golf, a sport she began practicing from a very young age and over the years progressed through circuits such as the Srixon Medalist Tour, the AJGA, and South Florida PGA competitions, where she achieved several standout results.

From youth golf to a more sophisticated image

Kai Trump is going through a new stage, and her recent look to celebrate her first year with the Miami Hurricanes is a sign of how much her style has evolved. The young golfer opted for an outfit in the University of Miami’s colors, with a striped sports polo, a white miniskirt, and matching sneakers.

The change is also noticeable in the way she presents her looks. The granddaughter of Donald Trump , who first began gaining notoriety mainly for her role as a golfer, seems increasingly comfortable with her public exposure and with an aesthetic that blends sports, fashion, and college life. The outfit reflects a much more polished and confident image than the one she showed years ago.

The granddaughter of one of the most influential men in the world made a post on her social media highlighting her choice of clothing, which turns the sporty look into the central element of the post.

Donald Trump is a well-known golf enthusiast, and Kai found in that sport a particularly visible point of connection with him; however, the golfer has sought to ensure that her last name is not the main reason for her presence on the courses. Her presence today is based on training and competition, and she now stands out for her transformation, leaving behind that little girl who accompanied her grandfather to build her own story.

Kai Trump , ultimately, is still just getting started. She has a last name that inevitably opens doors and draws attention, but also a sport in which she will have to show how much she can grow on her own merits.
